name: distribution_repair
scope: Re-review all 1839 original action identities from the same frozen issuer documents and structured sources. Preserve 1119 prior field-scoped acceptances and all 720 first failures. Original pre-repair action identities remain the audit join; active ETF data is not changed in this source phase.
changes: Support explicit current-period per-share and per-ten-share gross payout wording, including mid/final-period qualifiers and compound distribution/capitalization section headings. Exclude proposals, previously paid dividends, annual totals, tax-adjusted amounts, H-share-only amounts and theoretical ex-price adjustments.

Support additional explicitly labelled Shanghai date-table layouts, including share-listing columns and rows without a share-class column. Bind each date to the complete recognized header order; swapped, truncated or ambiguous columns do not pass.
Allow whitespace within year digits only while recognizing a role-labelled date; do not globally join adjacent numeric fields or infer a missing date.

Keep original single-document candidate, issuer, catalogue-date, structured-agreement, ambiguity and amount-precision requirements. Do not resolve multiple text candidates, unsupported providers, amended documents or conflicting events by return or convenience.
validation: Archive the previous extractor and preserve real before-failure tests before editing. Add adversarial layout, tax, historical-total, split-year, header-order and partial-evidence tests.

Re-run all 1839 events, require every previously accepted field value to remain supported, preserve every rejected source and original status. Extra fields on an accepted event need the same independent verification as newly accepted events.

Use a separate PyMuPDF-based text/geometry check for all added date/amount facts and preserve field/page/source hashes. Visually inspect every new layout family and every independent mismatch before accepting it; do not call the production extractor from the independent checker.

No active inputs, code in training/execution/planning, frozen ledgers or the current paper plan may change in this phase. Verify source hashes, all baseline file hashes and ordinary model reloads. Full local checks, actual CI and independent remote checks are required before publication.
integration_gate: After accepted source closure, separately register applying newly verified fields to the current ETF snapshot. Preserve fund_mode and every existing fact. Require exact parent rebuilding, immutable new data, full fitting, fixed-forecast and independent account/paper checks before activation. This source review alone cannot alter returns or clear data-quality flags.
risk: Balanced attack, 8% warning, original high-water mark, latched/non-recovering risk, positive_score and legacy turnover remain unchanged. No alpha candidates or relaxed gates.
limitations: Field verification does not certify all corporate-action terms, fractional shares or tax treatment.
Catalogue-plus-next-day is a retrospective convention, not a certified historical intraday timestamp.
Current-universe selection, remaining quote gaps, complete ETF economic exposure, contest matching and forward evidence remain open.
scope_changes: Exclude explicit proposed distribution clauses even inside an implementation section. Preserve actual paragraphs and existing document/candidate/precision gates.
Ignore only a fully delimited parenthesized A/H outstanding-share-count composition in amount-role screening; H-only payout clauses remain excluded.
Re-run all 1839 events and require all 1119 prior accepted facts. Retain the failed 1304-event first review unchanged. All added fields require the original independent source review.
